requirement.description: The next_token function has issues with comment handling in arrays and incomplete token detection. Several tests are failing due to improper handling of comments within array structures and incomplete token detection at the end of input.
requirement.contract:
Fix the next_token function to correctly handle comments within array structures and properly detect incomplete tokens at the end of input. The function should correctly process comments in arrays like [%a
/abc %b %c 
 123%d
] and properly identify incomplete tokens at the end of input.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function has issues with parsing arrays containing comments. Comments within arrays are not being properly skipped during parsing, causing incorrect parsing results.
requirement.contract: Modify the parse_obj function to correctly skip comments when parsing arrays. When encountering a COMMENT token within an array context, the parser should skip the entire comment and continue parsing subsequent elements.

requirement.description: The stream tokenization logic in next_token function needs improvement to properly handle stream content and endstream markers.
requirement.contract: Improve the stream tokenization logic to correctly identify stream content boundaries and endstream markers. The function should return the correct range for stream tokens including the content up to the endstream marker.

requirement.description: The text_string function has issues with UTF-16BE decoding, particularly with handling the BOM and special characters. The test test_literal_utf16be is failing because of incorrect handling of UTF-16BE encoded strings with BOM.
requirement.contract: Fix the text_string function to correctly handle UTF-16BE strings with BOM and ensure proper decoding of special characters like the Euro sign (€) when they appear in PDFDocEncoded strings.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function has issues with handling integer tokens at the end of input when they may be part of a reference pattern (integer 0 R). This leads to failures when parsing incomplete data structures.
requirement.contract: Enhance the parse_obj function to properly handle incomplete tokens at the end of input, especially when dealing with potential reference patterns (integer 0 R) that might not be fully formed.
